description:
The Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar is a prestigious award scheme initiated by the Government of India. 

It was launched in the year 2020. 

The scheme is overseen by the Department of Science and Technology. 

The primary objective of the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar is to recognize and honor outstanding contributions in the field of science and technology. 

The scheme aims to promote scientific temper and encourage innovation among the citizens of India. 

It seeks to inspire young scientists and researchers to pursue excellence in their respective fields. 

The awards are intended to foster a culture of scientific research and development in the country. 

The scheme has specific measurable targets for recognizing contributions in various scientific domains. 

The awards are given annually. 

The categories for the awards include individual awards and institutional awards. 

The individual awards are conferred upon scientists and researchers who have made significant contributions to science and technology. 

The institutional awards recognize organizations that have made notable contributions to scientific research and development. 

The Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar includes a cash prize along with a citation. 

The cash prize for individual awardees is set at INR 5 lakh. 

For institutional awardees, the cash prize is INR 10 lakh. 

The awards are presented during the National Science Day celebrations. 

National Science Day is celebrated on February 28 every year. 

This day commemorates the discovery of the Raman Effect by Sir C.V. Raman in 1928. 

The eligibility criteria for the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar are well-defined. 

Individual applicants must be Indian citizens. 

They should have made significant contributions to science and technology. 

There is no specific age limit for individual applicants. 

However, the contributions should be recent and impactful. 

For institutional awards, the organization must be registered in India. 

The organization should have a track record of significant contributions to scientific research. 

The application process for the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar is straightforward. 

Interested candidates or organizations must submit their applications online. 

The applications are to be submitted through the official website of the Department of Science and Technology. 

The application form requires detailed information about the contributions made. 

Applicants must provide supporting documents that validate their claims. 

These documents may include research papers, patents, or project reports. 

The deadline for submitting applications is typically set for December 31 each year. 

The evaluation process begins after the application deadline. 

A committee of experts reviews the applications. 

The committee assesses the contributions based on innovation, impact, and relevance. 

The final selection of awardees is made by the Department of Science and Technology. 

The results are usually announced in January. 

Awardees are invited to the National Science Day event for the formal presentation of awards. 

The Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar has seen a growing number of applications since its inception. 

In the first year of the awards, over 200 applications were received. 

The scheme has been successful in highlighting the importance of scientific research. 

It has also encouraged collaboration between academia and industry. 

The awards serve as a platform to showcase India's scientific achievements. 

They also aim to inspire the next generation of scientists. 

The Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar is part of a broader initiative to promote science and technology in India. 

The Government of India has been actively investing in research and development. 

In the Union Budget 2023-24, the allocation for the Department of Science and Technology was INR 15,000 crore. 

This reflects the government's commitment to enhancing the scientific ecosystem in the country. 

The Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar is an integral part of this ecosystem. 

It not only recognizes individual and institutional achievements but also promotes a culture of scientific inquiry. 

The awards have been instrumental in motivating young scientists to pursue careers in research. 

They also encourage established scientists to continue their innovative work. 

The recognition from the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar can significantly enhance the profile of awardees. 

It can lead to increased funding opportunities and collaborations. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from the scientific community. 

Many awardees have expressed that the recognition has boosted their morale. 

It has also increased visibility for their research work. 

The Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar is a step towards building a scientifically informed society. 

It aims to bridge the gap between science and the general public. 

By promoting scientific achievements, the scheme contributes to the overall development of the nation. 

The Government of India continues to emphasize the importance of science and technology in achieving sustainable development goals. 

The Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar is a testament to this commitment. 

It highlights the role of science in addressing societal challenges. 

The scheme is expected to evolve over the years. 

Future editions may include more categories or special awards for emerging fields. 

The government is keen on adapting the scheme to the changing landscape of science and technology. 

Overall, the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar stands as a beacon of recognition for scientific excellence in India. 

It plays a crucial role in motivating scientists and researchers to contribute to national development. 

The scheme is a vital component of India's vision for a knowledge-driven economy. 

It aims to position India as a global leader in scientific research and innovation. 

The Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar is not just an award but a celebration of scientific achievements. 

It embodies the spirit of inquiry and discovery that is essential for progress. 

The scheme continues to inspire future generations to engage with science and technology. 

Through this initiative, the Government of India seeks to create a robust scientific community. 

The Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar is a significant milestone in this journey.
